title: Transport-neutral backend contract (LAB-020, LAB-021, LAB-083)
unsupported_selection: unsupported_backend (exit 4); no stub pretends to work

logical_operations.preflight: prove containment and resource controls; refuse unsafe hosts
logical_operations.start: start a generation and return an opaque runtime mapping after verified health, signed identity, isolation and limits
logical_operations.observe: alive, or terminal state FAILED/EXPIRED/STOPPED with reason
logical_operations.stop: stop only the owned generation and verify death
logical_operations.call: guarded worker operation inside the managed context (ping, activate, set-lease, describe, aws, baseline, seed, verify, metrics; probe in test mode)
logical_operations.inspect: safe diagnostics: limits and usage, never secrets
logical_operations.cleanup: remove backend-private runtime files after verified death
logical_operations.endpoint_context: endpoint described in the backend's own context

remote_prerequisites_before_enabling: authenticated private control transport (e.g. SSH over WireGuard)
